content: I would vote in favor of restricting tobacco advertising to protect children and teenagers. Kids’ health and wellbeing should take priority over commercial interests, as tobacco products pose serious health risks to minors and can create lifelong addiction. Effective regulations can substantially limit exposure to persuasive marketing, especially among vulnerable age groups, while remaining consistent with public‑health goals and the moral responsibility of businesses to act ethically. In short: kids’ health matters more than advertisers’ freedom when it comes to preventing youth tobacco use.
